batch_differing_usage_limit: The usage limit differs between tokens.
batch_differing_hint: Some tokens were edited on their own, so these fields are left empty. As long as they stay empty, every token keeps its own setting. Anything you enter there applies to every token of the batch and replaces those individual settings.
batch_differing_usage_limit_help: Leave empty to keep each token's own limit.
batch_differing_usage_limit_lift: Lift the limit of every token
token_edit_hint: Changes apply to this token only. Views already spent are kept.

public_confirm_nothing_spent: Nothing is used until you press the button.
accessibility_ok_hint: Visitors with a valid token can watch this video.
accessibility_setup_title: How to configure a video at this provider
accessibility_issue_vimeo_password_prote: The video is password-protected, so viewers are asked for a Vimeo password instead of seeing the video. Set the privacy in the share dialog to "Embed only", "Unlisted" or "Public".
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_disabled: Embedding is turned off for this video, so it cannot play here at all. Open "Embed" in the share dialog and allow the domain this app is served from.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_whitelis: Embedding is limited to specific domains, but no domain is allowed yet. Add the domain this app is served from under "Embed" in the share dialog.
Plays only on these domains: {domains}. Visitors on any other domain see an error.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_unlisted_needs: Unlisted videos can only be embedded through their private link hash, which this app does not store. Set the privacy in the share dialog to "Embed only" instead.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_video_not_foun: This video no longer exists in the connected Vimeo account.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_unavaila: Vimeo did not return any embed code for this video.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_no_api_token: No Vimeo API token is configured, so only a basic embed check could run.
accessibility_issue_unknown_provider: This media uses a provider the app does not know.
accessibility_issue_check_failed: The check could not be completed. See the server log for details.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_open_share: Open the video on Vimeo and click "Share".
accessibility_setup_vimeo_privacy_option: Under "Privacy", pick "Embed only" (older accounts call it "Hide from Vimeo"), "Unlisted" or "Public" – with "Password" or "Private" the video cannot play here.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_open_embed: Still in the share dialog, click the round "Embed" button at the bottom.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_add_domain: Allow the domain this app runs on there. Add your local development origin too if you test there.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_recheck: Save on Vimeo, then run the playback check again here.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_whitelis: Plays only on these domains: {domains}. This app is served from {host}, so visitors here see an error. Add {host} on Vimeo.
groups_empty: No groups yet. Create a group to hand out one token for several media.
group_media_none: No media yet. Add media before creating a group.
group_media_hint: A token for this group unlocks each of these media, and spends its usage limit on each of them separately.
group_delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete "{name}"?
group_delete_confirm_hint: All access tokens for this group are deleted as well, so existing links and QR codes stop working. The media themselves are kept. This cannot be undone.
token_usage_limit_per_media_hint: Counted per medium of the group
public_group_intro: Pick what you want to watch.
public_group_blocked_hint: Some of these can no longer be opened with your link.
public_group_empty: There is nothing to watch behind this link at the moment. Please contact support.
footer_contrib_question: Questions, wishes or something not working?
statistics_intro: When which token opened which media. Only the moment of each view is kept – nothing about the visitor.
statistics_recent_views_hint: The {count} most recent views of the period, newest first.
token_history_hint: Every view this token spent, newest first. Nothing about the visitor is stored.
token_history_empty: This token has not spent any view yet.
token_history_unrecorded: {count} view was spent before the history was kept and has no entry here. | {count} views were spent before the history was kept and have no entries here.
